revision_note: i fixed timing and attribution after the review. no empirical futures grid has run. v2 and its lock are in research/. this revision allows declared optional exclusions and matched scenarios; the primary cannot be replaced.
question: how much of a futures signal survives later periods, other markets, costs and slower orders?
signal_timeframe: 1h UTC, start-stamped; signal known at scheduled hour end

momentum.rule: long when completed close is above the close lookback_hours observed completed hourly bars earlier within the current uninterrupted contract segment; otherwise flat

mean_reversion.rule: long when completed close is at least entry_z standard deviations below the mean of the prior lookback_hours observed completed hourly bars; exit when close reaches or exceeds that prior mean; reset at every contract transition

selection.metric: net Sharpe on daily account-capital returns in the base scenario
selection.tie_break: lower fill count, then configuration id
selection.validation_and_final_usage: report the locked development winner and rank changes; never tune on final results

execution.fill: first observed 1-minute open at or after completed signal bar end plus delay
execution.roll: advance instruction; first observed old-contract open after executable time plus delay and before deadline; reentry after boundary plus delay; fail if old exit unavailable

baselines: always long with the same scheduled roll policy and costs

statistics.daily_return: event P&L on the New York session date (18:00 starts the next date), divided by stated capital
statistics.annualization: 252 trading days; sample standard deviation; zero volatility Sharpe is undefined
statistics.uncertainty: paired circular block bootstrap at 3, 5 and 10 observed sessions; descriptive intervals, no correction for prior selection
statistics.walk_forward: candidate-selection diagnostic on continuously simulated strategies, using the prior three calendar years; not a switching portfolio
statistics.split_clock: split bounds are session-date labels stored at UTC midnight, not UTC event timestamps

prior_exposure: the local nq-powell project already reports NQ and cross-market results by year through 2026. no 2024-2026 period can honestly be called untouched; historical_final is a historical evaluation. version 1 was frozen before this project's grid ran. synthetic software results were inspected before version 2; no empirical results from the new nine-configuration grid have been viewed.
roll_gate: per-market identity, advance-policy and quality gates; required NQ must pass; only listed optional markets may be excluded
data_change_rule: a coverage correction can revise the plan only with a written reason and a new lock before viewing strategy performance

quality.invalid_bars: block on missing values, invalid OHLC/volume, duplicates or order errors
quality.gaps: retain observed bars only; no fills or imputation. all calendar labels are candidates unless product closure evidence is supplied; report uncertain gaps

research_questions: how many positive-gross candidates remain positive after costs at the same delay?
does the development winner beat a typical candidate and the two baselines later?
how stable are ranks across periods and allowed markets?
what changes under matched cost-only and delay-only stress?
how wide are paired intervals under the declared block lengths?
